## Services
- AC repair & diagnostics: Same-day diagnosis with gauges and meters, then a clear explanation before anything gets fixed.
- Compressors, capacitors & electrical: The parts that most often stop an AC cold, diagnosed and replaced.
- Refrigerant leaks & recharge: Leak detection, recovery and a correct refrigerant charge so the system cools like it should.
- AC & system replacement: New outdoor and indoor equipment, often installed start to finish in a day.
- Heating & furnaces: Furnace and heat pump repair and replacement before the first cold front.
- Commercial HVAC: Rooftop and package units serviced for businesses around Katy and Houston.

## About
Xtra Comfort Air Conditioning & Heating is a family-owned and operated HVAC company based in Katy. It holds Texas A/C contractor license TACLB158461E and carries 1 million in general liability insurance. Most customers meet Jack. Reviews describe him arriving the same evening a call came in, keeping the worksite clean and walking homeowners through what he found. Several of them found Xtra Comfort through a neighbor or friend, and the crew works on homes and commercial rooftop units alike.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: No. Xtra Comfort is open 24 hours, seven days a week, with same-day service. Reviewers in Katy describe Jack arriving in about 30 minutes.
- Q: Will I know the cost before you start?
  A: Yes. You get an upfront quote before any work begins, there are no hidden fees, and you pay only after the job is done.
- Q: Which brands do you work on?
  A: Trane, Lennox, Carrier, Goodman, Ruud, York and Amana, plus most other residential and commercial systems.
- Q: Do you service commercial buildings?
  A: Yes. The team repairs rooftop and package units for businesses around Katy and Houston.
- Q: Are you licensed and insured?
  A: Yes. Xtra Comfort holds Texas A/C contractor license TACLB158461E and carries 1 million in general liability coverage.
- Q: Can you replace a whole system in a day?
  A: Often, yes. One reviewer had a new outdoor unit and indoor system installed from start to finish within a day.
